name: @kickside/hubspot-ui
title: KickSide HubSpot Picker
description: Config picker web component for HubSpot CRM source and sink ports.

wippy.description: Provides the kickside-hubspot-picker web component for HubSpot source and sink configuration. Pass config containing the current connection_id and object_type; the component loads available HubSpot connections through the host proxy and emits config-changed with both values whenever the user updates the selection.

config.description: Current source/sink config containing connection_id and object_type.

config-changed.description: Emitted whenever connection_id or object_type changes.
